critical_code_review_comments: FIXED by testing agent: DecisionsTab was double-unwrapping axios responses (`rrspQ.data?.data`) causing the Decisions tab to silently show nothing after Compare/Optimize. All other tabs use the correct single-unwrap `q.data` pattern.

Retirement.jsx is 546 lines and bundles 6 tab components + helpers; consider splitting ProjectionTab / MonteCarloTab / GuardrailsTab / TimingTab / DecisionsTab / ScenariosTab into /pages/retirement/*.jsx for maintainability.

retirement.py router: `planner_scope` return value `read` is unused in list_scenarios (variable kept but never referenced since repo.list already uses scope-based read) — safe but noisy; consider dropping the alias.
ScenarioInput.inputs is `dict` with no schema validation — any payload persisted. For an advisor product consider at least key whitelisting to avoid storing PII inadvertently from the frontend form.

MonteCarloInput.numberOfPaths capped at 5000, but guardrails indirectly runs run_monte_carlo twice (base + flex) via run_guardrail_check; worst-case takes ~5s with paths=5000. Could add latency note or lower cap for guardrails.
